Glyos colorway palettes

Source: R/palettes.R
glyos_palettes.Rd

A named list of color palettes, one per colorway, covering Onell Design's Glyos line and the Glyos-compatible lines from partner companies such as TheGodBeast, Spy Monkey Creations, Toyfinity and the Four Horsemen. Each element is a character vector of two to six hex colors holding only the plastic and paint colors of that colorway, ordered so that the first few colors are the most distinct from one another (body color first, then secondary plastic, then paint accents). Use glyos_palette() to pull colors from a palette and glyos_colorways for background on each colorway, including which company made it.

Usage

glyos_palettes

Format

A named list of character vectors of hex colors.

Details

Hex values are approximations. Onell Design palettes were sampled from the reference product photograph in the Official Glyos Database (https://database.glyos.com/) and adjusted against Onell's published color descriptions. Partner-company palettes were sampled from the lead photograph of the figure's page on the Glyos Wiki (glyos.fandom.com). Clear, glow-in-the-dark, metallic and pearlescent plastics cannot be captured by a single flat color; those palettes reflect how the plastic photographs.

See also

glyos_palette(), glyos_palette_names(), glyos_companies(), glyos_colorways, glyos_show_palettes()

Examples

length(glyos_palettes)
#> [1] 208
glyos_palettes$spectre
#> [1] "#EEFADA" "#BCC99B" "#9EB49A" "#5FC3A8"
glyos_palettes$kabuto_infection
#> [1] "#E61B11" "#911708" "#F86A62"
